item.title: Compare an Old Photo and a New One
item.prompt_text: A friend shows you an old photo of a small square. It had two benches and one tree. Your new photo shows four benches, three small trees and a path between them. Tell your friend what has changed and say where you would sit now.
item.target_grammar: There was and there were for the past, and there is or are for the present.
item.fluency_objective: Give the old view before the new one. Listen back and check the change in numbers.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress two and four so the before and after details are clear.

cues.text: Describe at least two changes in the new photo.
Choose a place to sit with a reason.

item.model_opening: In the old photo, there were two benches and one tree.
item.model_answer: In the old photo, there were two benches and one tree. All the seats were close to the road. Now there are four benches and three small trees. There is also a path between them. I would sit on the bench next to the path because I could see people coming into the square. I could sit there with a friend without listening to the cars all the time.
